verdict.rationale: Factory offers some isolation for agent work: the Factory App runs each session in a separate, isolated working directory (worktree). Droid Computers, including registered BYOM machines, give it dedicated execution environments, and tiered autonomy gates which operations run without confirmation. None of the evidence describes a sandbox environment for testing, or any separation from production data or services. missing for 10: an explicit sandbox or test environment capability, guarantees that production data or services are isolated, and documentation or hands-on corroboration of safe testing against non-production resources.
